test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)

question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"disturbed."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Disturbed" **means to disrupt or interrupt the normal functioning of something or someone. (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति के सामान्य कामकाज में बाधा डालना या बाधित करना) • **Example**:* She **disturbed__** me.* • The sentence suggests that something prevented an action from happening, so **"prevented"** could also be a possible option. • However, the context of the sentence implies that the prevented action would have been beneficial, making **"disturbed"** a better fit. • The correct answer is Option 1. • Correct passage: ......I had __**disturbed**__ the leopard in his quest for food.........​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "facilitated", **means to make something easier or smoother. (किसी चीज़ को आसान या सहज बनाना) • **Option 3, "helped", **means to assist or aid someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु की सहायता करना) • **Option 4, "prevented", **means to stop something from happening. (किसी चीज़ को घटित होने से रोकना) 46:Taa2, The correct answer is **"encounter."**
